limitations: Three synthetic scenarios execute the real current SolutionExecutor/GraphExecutor/GroupBreak/GroupOutputAccumulator and normal helper calls; no vendor/native runtime, real tool algorithm, WPF, device or numerical parity test.
Synthetic Parent/Worker implement only data production, identity forwarding, intentional failure and observed IDisposable callbacks. They do not replace the Group/graph implementation.

Tracker deliberately retains source PortValues, emitted frames and input references to compare identity; readability after module Dispose is not a measurement of last-owner release, GC, native memory, caches outside this runner or memory peaks.
The returned last-session tree is observed. No unavailable prior session tree or unexecuted third iteration is synthesized.
The finite zero-range required-output failure is this current configuration's real result; it is not a claim about all Group zero-range configurations or original-program parity.
Compiler PDB checksums bind every compiled source document to current files, but do not establish original-program equivalence.
